message: Scaffold Cargo project with clap CLI skeleton
Implement homeos.yml config parsing with serde
Refactor all unit tests to follow 3A pattern (Arrange / Act / Assert)
Implement `homeos cd` to launch a subshell in the default repo directory
Implement `homeos package list` to display packages from homeos.yml
Implement `homeos package add <pkg>` to create package directory and config entry
Implement `homeos package remove <pkg>` to remove config entry from homeos.yml
Add skeleton script generation to `homeos package add`
Add confirmation prompt with testable plan logic
